fit: isolated ginger compounds and artificial permeability
assessment: The contemporaneous related abstract reports an artificial membrane assay. The original journal article is restricted and no clinical anxiety or grated ginger effect is established.

fit: dietary gingerol-enriched extract and open-field behavior in diabetic rats
assessment: Figure 1 reports more center time and entries in extract-treated neuropathy rats. Methods describes eight weeks, while Results references five. Open-field measures and concentrated extract do not resolve culinary ginger and clinical anxiety.

fit: oral gingerol extract and open-field behavior in female rats with nerve ligation
assessment: Center entries increased for the higher dose versus ligation vehicle at week four in Figure 2, p < .05. The abstract describes both doses more broadly. Concentrated extract and a pain-model behavior do not establish an effect on Parkinson anxiety.
